rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=600, val_n=16, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.001, unet_c=16, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-2: ONE knob n_iter 300->600. Hypothesis: the per-scan self-supervised Adam fit is under-converged at 300 steps (iter-1 hr=0, PSNR 37.38 < LD-FBP 39.68); doubling per-scan steps lets each val scan recover more high-freq detail and close the gap to the 128-view LD-FBP baseline (mirrors the Mayo n2i iter-2 n_iter-up move). val_n kept at 16; iter-1 ran in 421s so 2x n_iter ~14min stays under the 15min wall.
